extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators, research administrators, and authorized institutional representatives applying to U.S. DOE Office of Science funding opportunities
extracted.subtask_short: DOE Office of Science FOA applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and posting of Funding Opportunity Announcements (FOAs) from the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science, listing requirements, deadlines, submission systems, and supporting materials for preparing and submitting grant applications, pre-applications, and letters of intent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical description of work to be funded
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding announcement issued by the Office of Science provides a technical description of the type of work to be funded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should read the FOA's technical description to ensure proposed work aligns with the programmatic scope and goals specified in the announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information about type, size, number, and duration of awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding announcement provides information about the type, size, number, and duration of awards expected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should align budgets, project durations, and requested award types with the parameters and expectations stated in the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding announcement provides eligibility criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm institutional and PI eligibility before preparing an application; some announcements are limited (e.g., 'Open only to DOE Laboratories').

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions for submissions and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding announcement provides instructions for submission of letters of intent (if required), preapplications or preproposals (if required), and applications or proposals; due dates and times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the FOA's submission instructions precisely, observing specified deadlines and required submission components (LOI, pre-application, full application).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and selection information including merit review criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding announcement provides review and selection information, including merit review criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design proposals to address the FOA's stated review/merit criteria; note that DOE National Laboratory announcements state proposals will be subjected to formal merit review (peer review).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency points of contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Each funding announcement provides agency points of contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed points of contact for programmatic or administrative questions; contact PAMS helpdesk or FOA contacts as directed for system or submission issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of specified submission portals and systems
rubrics_metrics.description: The page references specific submission systems such as Grants.gov and PAMS for submission of applications, pre-applications, and letters of intent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit materials via the portals designated in the FOA (e.g., Grants.gov for applications, PAMS for some letters of intent/pre-apps), and observe the portal-specific deadlines and format requirements. Contact PAMS helpdesk for assistance (phone/email provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre‑application / pre‑proposal / letter of intent requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Some FOAs require a pre-application, pre-proposal, or letter of intent to be submitted by a specified date/time and via a specified system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the FOA requires these preliminary submissions, prepare and submit them by the stated deadline and using the specified channel; failure to submit required pre-documents can render an application ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorized institutional representative submission requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain program announcements require that a pre-proposal (or similar submission) 'must be submitted by an authorized institutional representative.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure submissions that require institutional authorization are submitted by the institution's authorized official (e.g., Sponsored Projects Office or AOR), not by an individual PI alone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to FOA-provided templates, sample agreements, and FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: The page lists availability of Phase I and Phase II application templates, sample OT and Project Agreements, and FAQs and webinar materials for certain FOAs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the FOA-provided templates and review sample agreements, FAQs, and webinar recordings/slides to ensure applications conform to formatting, content, and administrative expectations described by the Office of Science.
